title: Human-Activity AGV Quality Assessment: A Benchmark Dataset and an Objective Evaluation Metric

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing subjective quality scores (Mean Opinion Scores) of AI-generated videos across text prompts specifying different age groups (e.g., child, youth, middle-aged, elderly) to see if generation quality differs.
Comparing subjective quality scores (Mean Opinion Scores) of AI-generated videos across text prompts specifying different genders (male, female) to see if generation quality differs.

Comparing subjective quality scores (Mean Opinion Scores) of AI-generated videos across text prompts specifying different racial or ethnic groups (e.g., white race, yellow race, black race) to see if generation quality differs.
